name: print-social-jewelled-cake-slice-post-with-glitter-starbursts
title: Lilac post with a rhinestone-covered cake slice, glitter cobalt starbursts and a rounded cobalt caption
whatItIs: A lilac portrait with two glitter cobalt starbursts with yellow edges at the corners, a cutout slice of pink-frosted sponge covered in gems and pearls with two lit candles, a blue script-like title at the right and a cobalt pill with cream caps at the bottom with sparkle stars.
whatItMeans: Glamorous and funny; a jewelled cake makes 'stuffed' English feel like a party.
techniques: Use one lavish cutout as the hero.
Set a chunky title in cobalt.
Use a rounded pill for the caption.

vocabulary.definition: A large spiky shape in a corner.
